About
At NestHaven Properties, we believe that every property journey is personal. Whether you're buying your first home, selling a family property, searching for the perfect rental, or building your investment portfolio, we're committed to making the process straightforward, transparent, and rewarding.
Since our establishment, we have built our reputation on integrity, professionalism, and exceptional service. Our experienced estate agents combine in-depth local market knowledge with innovative technology and data-driven insights to help clients make informed property decisions with confidence.
We understand that no two clients are the same. That's why we take the time to understand your goals, provide honest advice, and tailor our approach to your unique needs. From accurate property valuations and strategic marketing to skilled negotiation and seamless transactions, we are dedicated to delivering outstanding results every step of the way.
At NestHaven Properties, we don't just facilitate property transactions — we build lasting relationships founded on trust, reliability, and a genuine commitment to our clients' success.
We operate on the EstateAgently platform, the same operating system that powers a select group of independent agencies across South Africa, which gives us a quiet technological edge in qualification, market intelligence, and client experience.
Whether you're buying, selling, renting, or investing, you can count on NestHaven Properties to help you find your place to call home.
Meet our team 
Operating principles
Five principles. Held loosely.
01 Discretion
We default to private. Where our clients want privacy, they get it.
02 Restraint
Less listing volume, more attention per mandate.
03 Directness
You work with the practitioner you met, not a successor.
04 Patience
Considered preparation outperforms rushed marketing every time.
05 Honesty
About the market, the home, and the likely outcome — even when it costs us a mandate.
services:
What we do
Eight services, one team.
Eight property services, all delivered by our experienced team of accredited practitioners. Engagement is always direct — the agent you meet is the agent who works with you.
01 Residential Property Sales
Selling a property requires more than simply listing it on the market. At NestHaven Properties, we provide end-to-end sales services designed to maximise your property's value while ensuring a smooth and stress-free experience. From pricing your property correctly and creating compelling marketing campaigns to negotiating offers and managing the transaction through to registration, we are with you every step of the way.
02 Residential Property Rentals
Whether you're a landlord looking for reliable tenants or a tenant searching for your next home, we make the rental process simple and efficient. We market rental properties, conduct viewings, assist with tenant placement, and provide guidance throughout the leasing process to help both landlords and tenants achieve successful outcomes.
03 Property Market Valuations
An accurate property valuation is the foundation of every successful property transaction. Our experienced estate agents combine local market expertise, recent comparable sales, neighbourhood trends, and current market conditions to provide reliable market valuations. Whether you're selling, refinancing, investing, or simply curious about your property's value, we provide the insights you need to make informed decisions.
04 Property Marketing
Exceptional properties deserve exceptional marketing. We develop tailored marketing strategies that showcase your property's best features through professional photography, engaging property descriptions, online property portals, social media marketing, and our network of qualified buyers. Our objective is to maximise exposure and attract serious buyers or tenants in the shortest possible time.
05 Buyer and Seller Representation
Buying or selling a property is one of life's most significant financial decisions. We represent our clients with professionalism, integrity, and dedication throughout the entire process. From property searches and viewings to negotiations, offers, contracts, and transfer coordination, we work to protect your interests while ensuring a seamless transaction.
06 Landlord and Tenant Support
Successful rental relationships are built on clear communication and professional guidance. We assist landlords and tenants throughout the rental journey by providing advice on lease agreements, rental processes, legal obligations, and best practices. Our goal is to help create positive, long-term rental relationships that benefit both parties.
07 Investment Property Guidance
Property remains one of the most effective long-term wealth-building assets when approached strategically. We help property investors identify suitable investment opportunities by providing market insights, suburb performance information, rental demand analysis, and guidance on potential returns. Whether you're purchasing your first investment property or expanding an existing portfolio, we're here to support your investment objectives.
08 Professional Property Advice
Every property decision deserves expert guidance. Our experienced estate agents are available to provide honest, practical advice tailored to your unique circumstances. Whether you need assistance understanding market conditions, preparing your property for sale, navigating the buying process, or exploring investment opportunities, we offer trusted advice to help you move forward with confidence.

How It Works
How It Works
Ready to discover what your property is worth? Here's how our simple valuation process works.
01 Request a Valuation for Your Property
Complete our contact form. One of our experienced estate agents will get in touch to arrange a property viewing.
02 Show Us Your Property
Your dedicated estate agent will visit your property, assess its features and condition, answer any questions you may have and provide advice, where required.
03 Receive Your Property Valuation
Within 24 hours, you'll receive a comprehensive market valuation report, including an estimated market value, recent comparable sales, local market trends, and recommendations to help you make informed decisions.
